name: block-language-marquee
use: The end of a page about a product that speaks many languages: all 82 languages crawl across the screen, each written in its own script, with CSS only.
avoid: Anywhere but the end of a page; a list of the languages a page is actually translated into.

cases.title: Sign-in screens in 82 languages, at the end of the page
cases.why: The ribbon shows the languages instead of naming a number.

props.title: Speaks the language of your visitors
props.note: The sign-in screens are shown in the language of the visitor.

docs: npx shadcn add @fractera/block-language-marquee. The styles .marquee* come with the theme of Fractera elements; config/translations/language-metadata comes with the element template. In a page: { "kind": "block-language-marquee", "title": "…" } last.
